content: Confirmed: `Runner.RunOnce`/`NewRunner` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` are defined but not wired into any server startup path — the only live triggers are the two direct calls in `memo_service.go`.

I now have all the pieces needed.

h14.

**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which delegates the actual parsing to `markdownService.ExtractAll(content)` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-421`. The result is written into `store.Memo.Payload` (`storepb.MemoPayload`, `Tags` and `Property` fields).

**Triggers (recomputation):** only two live call sites, both in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`:
- `CreateMemo` — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` at `memo_service.go:108`, run on every new memo.
- `UpdateMemo` — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)` at `memo_service.go:447`, run **only** when the update mask includes the `content` path (i.e., only when the memo body actually changes — updates to visibility, pinned, etc. do not recompute it).

Note: `Runner.RunOnce`/`NewRunner` (same file, `runner.go:19-72`) implement a batch "rebuild all memos" pass intended as a maintenance/migration job, but a repo-wide search (`memopayload\.` across all `*.go`) shows it's never invoked from `server/server.go` or anywhere else — it's defined but not wired into startup, unlike the analogous `s3presign` runner which is explicitly started (`server/server.go:162-169`). So in practice recomputation only happens on create/content-update, not on any schedule.

**Extracted properties** (via a single markdown AST walk in `ExtractAll`, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-421`):
- `Tags` — collected from `#tag` markdown nodes, deduplicated case-preserving.
- `Property.Title` — text of the first block if it's an H1 heading (`extractHeadingText`).
- `Property.HasLink` — set if any markdown link node is present.
- `Property.HasCode` — set if any code block/fenced code block/code span is present.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — set if any task checkbox node is present.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — set if any task checkbox is unchecked.
- (Also `Mentions` are extracted into `ExtractedData.Mentions` by the same walk, but `RebuildMemoPayload` currently only copies `Tags` and `Property` into the stored payload — `runner.go:85-86` — so mentions aren't persisted onto `MemoPayload` at this stage, per the in-repo mention-feature design doc under `docs/plans/2026-04-06-memo-mentions/`.)
